line: Give a genuine "well done" to someone behind the scenes.
paragraph: A man named Rhys Wynne-Jones walked into St. Mary's Church in Penzance on a cold January night. He had been homeless for ten years in England and needed shelter. He sat down at the piano and played. Someone recorded it. The video went viral. Two years later he says his whole life has turned around. He has also raised fifty thousand dollars for charity.

seed.summary: A homeless man who was recorded playing piano in a church on a cold January night says his whole life has turned around, in the two years since his performance went viral.
